notItems.alteration: It is not a finding that a document was altered dishonestly, and it says nothing about the person.
notItems.ordinary: Many ordinary steps leave the same traces: signing, filling in a form, merging pages, compressing, converting from an e-mail, printing again.
notItems.absence: A document with no trace is not declared genuine: a file made again from scratch leaves none.
notItems.person: A person decides. Verikora decides nothing.

ordinary.history: Signing, filling in a form, merging pages, compressing the file or converting it from an e-mail leave the same traces as an edit.
ordinary.layout: A different font on one line can come from a template, a form field, a stamp, or a page the issuer added later.
ordinary.images: A photo saved again, cropped, rotated or sent through a messaging app changes the same data.
ordinary.figures: Rounding, a bonus, retroactive pay, a second employer or a correction by the payroll office can make figures differ.
ordinary.across: Two jobs, a split deposit, another bank account or a raise can explain two documents that do not match.

askFor.history: Ask for the document downloaded from the issuer's portal (the payroll portal for a pay stub), or the original file as the issuer sent it.
askFor.layout: Ask for the original file as the issuer produced it, not a copy that was opened and saved again.
askFor.images: Ask for the original file, or a new photo with the whole document flat and well lit.
askFor.figures: Call the issuer on a number you found yourself, and ask for a copy from their records.
askFor.across: Call the employer on a number you found yourself, and ask the applicant to explain the difference.

photoOrigin.header: Read on your photos at upload, before their metadata was removed: facts about the files, not an expert examination. They do not say whether the document is authentic.
photoOrigin.where: The photos' metadata, read at upload

declared.observation: The photos declare the device “{device}” and the software “{software}”.
declared.mayIndicate: Nothing in itself: it is what the device or the software wrote when it saved the photo.

absent.observation: The photos declare no device, no software and no capture date.
absent.mayIndicate: Metadata removed. Messaging apps, screenshots and social networks also remove it by default.

noDevice.observation: The photos declare no capture device: most likely a screenshot or an export.
noDevice.mayIndicate: Nothing about authenticity. Noted because a photo of a paper document usually carries the device's name.

modifiedAfter.observation: A photo declares it was modified after it was taken: taken {taken}, modified {modified}.
modifiedAfter.mayIndicate: A later save. A rotation, a crop or an export from the photo library leave the same trace.

modifiedBefore.observation: A photo declares a modification date ({modified}) earlier than its capture ({taken}).
modifiedBefore.mayIndicate: Dates rewritten, or a device clock set wrong — which also happens after a time-zone change.

gpsRemoved.observation: A photo carried a GPS position. It was removed at upload and never kept.
gpsRemoved.mayIndicate: Nothing about authenticity: most phones write it by default.

registry.title: Business registers
registry.lead: The numbers printed on the document, read against public registers. A question to ask the issuer, never a verdict on the document.
registry.nothingToAsk: The register holds this number: nothing to ask.

notLookedUp.bad-format: Not looked up: the number is not in the expected format.
notLookedUp.unavailable: Not looked up: the register did not answer.
notLookedUp.not-authorised: Not looked up: this register is not consulted yet.
notLookedUp.not-covered: Not looked up: this register is not consulted.

REG-001.observation: The QST number printed on the document was not found in the {source} register.
REG-001.mayIndicate: A typing error, a number not yet registered, or a number that belongs to another business.
REG-001.askFor: Ask the issuer to confirm the QST number.

REG-002.observation: The name printed on the document differs from the name in the register.
REG-002.mayIndicate: A trade name, a recent change of name, or an abbreviation.
REG-002.askFor: Ask the issuer how the two names relate.

REG-003.observation: The {source} register shows this registration revoked or cancelled as of {date}, on or before the date of the document.
REG-003.mayIndicate: A registration closed and reopened under the same number, or a late filing.
REG-003.askFor: Ask the issuer for the current registration.

incidents.title: Confidentiality incidents
incidents.lead: The register required by Law 25 (ss. 3.5 to 3.8): every incident, serious or not, kept five years. It holds facts and categories of information, never a person's data. Assess the risk of serious injury; if there is one, notify the Commission d'accès à l'information and the people concerned, then close.
incidents.descriptionHint: Facts only. No name, e-mail or document content.
incidents.informationHint: Comma-separated, e.g. lease, pay stub. Never the information itself.
incidents.measureText: A measure to reduce the risk or prevent a new incident
incidents.closedNote: This entry is closed. It stays in the register and is never edited again.

flows.lead: Each flow is data: who it is offered to, the Sovkora Studio and rulesets of its steps, the consents it requires, its price. A published version never changes; enable it per environment.

storage.title: Storage
storage.lead: Where documents and avatars are kept. The providers and their keys live in the database, sealed; the environment only holds the vault key. A provider is tested before it can be used, and every change is in the audit log.
storage.none: No provider is set: nothing is kept, and uploads answer that storage is not configured.
storage.newKeyHint: Typed once, sealed, never shown again. It is tested before anything is saved.
storage.addLead: The provider is saved as a draft and tested at once. It can be used only once the test passes. Files are encrypted before they leave, with a key generated here.
storage.label: Name
storage.enteredOnce: Entered once, sealed, never shown back.

move.title: Move the documents
move.lead: Each document is copied to the new provider, read back, and its SHA-256 checked. Only then does it point to the new provider. Nothing is deleted until you retire the old one. Until then, reads try the new provider first and the old one second.

avatarMaxKb.label: Largest uploaded avatar

batchMaxRows.hint: Above it, the preview refuses the batch and says to split it.

batchConcurrency.label: A batch's checks run at once

webhookMaxAttempts.label: Tries per webhook delivery

apiKeys.hint: Number of active keys. 0: the plan has no API.

webhookEndpoints.hint: Number of endpoints. 0: the plan has no webhooks.

enabled.label: Promo codes on
enabled.hint: Shows the promo code field and accepts codes. Off by default; the coupons themselves are managed in the Coupons tab.

reservationMinutes.label: Checkout hold
reservationMinutes.hint: Minutes a code is held for a checkout in progress. From 40 to 1440 (the payment page's own window).

attemptsPerAccountPerHour.label: Tries per account and hour
attemptsPerAccountPerHour.hint: How many codes one account may try in an hour.

attemptsPerIpPerHour.label: Tries per address and hour
attemptsPerIpPerHour.hint: How many codes one address may try in an hour.

minCodeLength.label: Shortest code
minCodeLength.hint: The fewest characters an administrator may type for a code.

generatedCodeLength.label: Generated code length
generatedCodeLength.hint: Characters in a generated code (letters and digits without I, L, O or U).

maxPercentOff.label: Largest discount
maxPercentOff.hint: The highest percentage a discount may take off. A free offer is a capped credit code, never a 100 % discount.

refundRestoresUse.label: A full refund gives the use back
refundRestoresUse.hint: Off by default, so a refund cannot reset a single-use code.

userConnectors.label: Cloud connections (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive)
userConnectors.hint: Lets people connect a cloud they already have as the home of their kept documents. Off until the app registrations are in place.

packs.lead: Each rules pack is a flow: turning it off removes it for consumers of this environment, at once.

sovkora.notExposed: Sovkora's own plan and usage figures are not exposed by its API yet: they are not shown rather than guessed.
sovkora.rotate: Rotating the key is done in Sovkora, then in the app's secret: it is not done from here.

organisation.notSeeded: Nothing seeded yet for this kind.

tags.name: Name of tag {position}
tags.writersHint: The roles that create, rename, remove and assign tags.
tags.userTags: People can add their own tags

status.finalHint: A final state has no way out.
status.initialNotFinal: The initial state is never final
status.states: States, in the order of the column
status.movesHint: Who may move a file from one state to another.
status.roles: Roles that can make this move
status.derived: Derived: the product computes this status; nobody moves it

prices.lead: The prices are data: a change applies from the day you choose (today or later), the history keeps every version, and a subscription keeps the price it was sold at. Every price is in CAD, plus taxes.
prices.processorOff: Payments are not configured on this installation: nothing is charged.
prices.amountHint: In dollars, e.g. 0.65. Empty: on quote (only for an entry not on sale).
prices.availabilityHint: Public: shown with its figure. Internal: never on a public page. In preparation: shown without a figure.
prices.fromHint: Empty or today: from now. A later day: from its start.
prices.chargedHint: Sales stop while it differs from the catalogue: sync the processor (test mode) below.
prices.notFound: Price not found at the processor.

editor.keepsPrice: Current subscriptions keep the price they were sold at.

confirm.title: Change the price of {name}?
confirm.now: From now: {before} → {after}. New sales use the new price at once; subscriptions already sold keep theirs.
confirm.later: From {date}: {before} → {after}. Nothing changes before that day; subscriptions already sold keep their price.
confirm.processorTest: The processor (test mode) gets the matching price.
confirm.processorLive: The processor is in LIVE mode: its price is not changed from here, the owner does it.

sync.title: Processor prices
sync.hint: Creates at the processor the price of each sold entry that differs from the catalogue (test mode only). A price already sold is never edited: a new one takes its lookup key.
sync.live: The processor is in live mode: only the owner changes its prices.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.lead: Discount and credit codes for partners, promotions and demos. Our database is the source of truth: the payment page only applies the discount from our terms. A credit code always has an expiry and, usually, a daily or monthly cap.
coupons.off: Promo codes are off: customers don't see the field. Turn them on in Plans, « Promo codes on ».
coupons.codeHint: Letters and digits, read without case, spaces or hyphens.
coupons.percentHint: Up to the largest discount in Plans. 100 % is never allowed.
coupons.capHint: Empty: no cap of this kind.
coupons.onExhaustedHint: Stop, or fall back to the paid plan.
coupons.redemptionsNote: Accounts appear by identifier only. A late payment is honoured and flagged.
coupons.partnersLead: The people who sell with a code. A name and an optional e-mail, seen by administrators only, used to attribute sales. Commission is not computed here.
coupons.reportNote: Uses, discount given and revenue (paid minus refunded) per code. Never a customer. Each reading is logged.

checks.title: Checks
checks.lead: Every check, its result and its run — newest first.

empty.title: No check yet
empty.text: Drop a lease, a pay stub or an invoice: Verikora reads it against Québec's rules and the result lands here.

checks.caption: Your checks

noMatch.title: No check matches
noMatch.text: Loosen a filter, or clear them all.

UNSUPPORTED_KIND.title: No rules for this kind of document yet
UNSUPPORTED_KIND.hint: Nothing was checked: Verikora has no rules for this kind of document yet. This is not a clean result.

KIND_UNKNOWN.title: Could not tell what kind of document this is
KIND_UNKNOWN.hint: Nothing was checked: pick the kind of document you are sending, then run the check again. This is not a clean result.

reportFace.label: The result
reportFace.attentionNone: No problem found on the {rules} rules checked
reportFace.notApplicableOne: {count} rule does not apply to this document
reportFace.notApplicableMany: {count} rules do not apply to this document
reportFace.onlyYou: You alone, unless you share it.
reportFace.history: Every run of this document, newest first.
reportFace.notCheckedText: Start a check: the verdict comes first, then every finding with its line.
reportFace.fileAndText: The file, its text, and what Verikora read in it.
reportFace.noQuote: No passage of the document quoted

batch.title: Check a batch of documents
batch.lead: A CSV file (one row per document) and the documents it names, dropped together. Before anything starts, the preview says what will be checked, reused or refused, and what it costs.
batch.drop: Drop the CSV and its documents
batch.inputLabel: Choose the CSV and its documents
batch.hint: CSV + PDF, Word or text — up to 10 MB per document
batch.summary: {check} to check · {reuse} already checked, reused at no cost · {refused} refused

cost.covered: This batch uses {audits} audit(s); you have {credits} credit(s).
cost.short: This batch needs {audits} audit(s) and you have {credits} credit(s): the rows not covered wait for your purchase.

batch.fromCheckLink: Import a batch from a CSV
batch.engineBusy: Sovkora is busy with other checks: the remaining rows wait their turn and start by themselves. Nothing to do.
batch.exportReadme:
Verikora — reports of a batch of checks.

lot.csv lists every row: its state, the reason when it did not run, and its file here.
rapports/ holds the signed PDF of each compliance check.
signaux/ holds the signals of each authenticity check, as Sovkora returned them.

These are informative checks, not legal advice. To verify a signed report, sign in to Verikora and open https://www.verikora.com/app/verifications/report (only the people the report's owner gave access to can).
The Québec rules are still to be reviewed by a lawyer.

notFound.title: This page does not exist.
notFound.text: It may have moved, or it is not yours.

dossiers.title: Applicant files
dossiers.lead: The documents you asked an applicant for, as they come in, each with its checks.
dossiers.caption: Your applicant files, newest first

empty.title: No applicant file yet
empty.text: Ask an applicant for their documents: Verikora checks each one, and you decide.

notOffered.title: Applicant files are for property managers
notOffered.text: Choose that role in your profile to ask for and check an applicant's documents.

form.title: Ask for documents
form.lead: The applicant gets a link to send the documents you choose, and only those. A social insurance number, a health card, a passport, a licence or bank details are never asked for.
form.name: Applicant's name

made.title: The link for {name}
made.text: Valid until {date}. It is shown once: copy it and hand it to the applicant. No document travels by e-mail.

detail.kept: Kept until your decision (the applicant agreed)
detail.purged: Deleted after its checks; the report stays
detail.afterCheck: Deleted once its checks have run
detail.skipped: A check could not run on this document

check.nothing: Nothing found on the rules checked

views.label: File views
views.name: View name
views.saveHint: The view keeps the filters of the address: the link stays the same on another device.

bulk.label: Actions on the selection
bulk.noTags: No tag yet: create one from a file.
bulk.done: Done: {moved} decided, {skipped} left as they were.
bulk.tooMany: At most {max} files at a time

decide.title: Your decision
decide.final: A decision is final: the file closes and its documents are erased; its reports stay.

share.title: Link for the building owner
share.lead: A read-only report: hashes and findings only, no name, no document. You choose how long it opens, 30 days at most.
share.created: Link ready. It is shown once: copy it now.

email.title: Send by e-mail
email.hint: The e-mail holds the link, its end date and your note: nothing from the report. The address is kept only while the link lives.

rentShare.title: Rent and income
rentShare.lead: If the applicant gave you their monthly income, type it with the monthly rent to see the share. Nothing you type here is sent or kept.

error.title: This page could not be shown
error.text: The server did not answer as expected. Your documents are kept; try again in a moment.

bundle.title: The lease and its annexes
bundle.lead: Every finding of the lease and of each annex, by line, with the article the rule cites. A check informs: it gives no advice and no verdict.
bundle.none: No rule needs a look on the documents checked so far.
bundle.toReview: Québec rules still to be reviewed by a lawyer: a demonstration screen, not legal advice.

bulk.label: Actions on the selection
bulk.noTags: No bookmark yet: create one in Settings > Bookmarks.
bulk.tooMany: At most {max} documents at a time

documentsPage.nothingWithBookmarks: No document wears all of these bookmarks.
documentsPage.title: All documents
documentsPage.lead: All your documents, newest first, across all your collections.
documentsPage.caption: All your documents, newest first

promo.label: Promo code
promo.hint: A discount applies to your next payment. A code that gives credits is added to your account at once.

paymentProblem.title: Your last payment did not go through
paymentProblem.text: The processor could not charge your card, so your plan is paused until it is updated. Nothing else changes: your documents and reports stay as they are.

paymentReturn.paidTitle: Thank you, your payment went through

paid.document: Your document check is on its way to your account: the balance updates in a few seconds, once the payment processor confirms.
paid.agency: Your plan is being activated: it shows on your account in a few seconds, once the payment processor confirms.
paid.firm: Your plan is being activated: it shows on your account in a few seconds, once the payment processor confirms.

paymentReturn.cancelled: You left the checkout before paying. You can come back to it from your account whenever you like.

bookmarks.lead: Your own coloured categories. A bookmark groups files; taking one away never deletes them.
bookmarks.deleteKeeps: The bookmark is taken off its files. The files themselves are kept.

unreadable.pdf: We could not read this PDF well enough to check it. Try again, or choose another copy of the document.
unreadable.scan: This PDF is a scan or a photo: we could not read its text. Choose a version you can select text in, or try again.
unreadable.office: We could not open this document. Save it again as a PDF or a Word file and choose it again, or try again.
unreadable.text: We could not read this text file. Check that it is not empty, then try again or choose another file.
unreadable.other: We could not read this file. Choose a PDF or a Word file, or try again.

refused.pdf: This PDF is not in a form we can check. Choose another copy of the document, or try again.
refused.scan: This scan is not in a form we can check. Choose a PDF you can select text in, or try again.
refused.office: This document is not in a form we can check. Save it as a PDF and choose it again.
refused.text: This text is not in a form we can check. Paste it into a document and save it as a PDF, then choose it again.
refused.other: This file is not in a form we can check. Choose a PDF or a Word file.

interrupted.pdf: The check stopped before the end, through no fault of your document. Try again.
interrupted.scan: The check stopped before the end, through no fault of your document. Try again.
interrupted.office: The check stopped before the end, through no fault of your document. Try again.
interrupted.text: The check stopped before the end, through no fault of your file. Try again.
interrupted.other: The check stopped before the end, through no fault of your file. Try again.
